== Historical Content ==
Use this notice on a page about removed content, an item that can no longer be obtained, or unused content. It leaves the rest of the page unchanged. Dates use month, day, and year, such as July 13, 2026.

* <code>state</code>: <code>removed</code>, <code>unobtainable</code>, or <code>unused</code>.
* <code>thing</code>: A lowercase noun, such as skill or item.
* <code>update</code>: The update name, if known.
* <code>date</code>: The update date, if known.
* <code>url</code>: A link to the update's patch notes, if known.

<pre>{{Historical Content|state=removed|thing=skill|update=Planar March|date=July 13, 2026|url=https://steamstore-a.akamaihd.net/news/externalpost/steam_community_announcements/1837955055363541}}</pre>
</noinclude>
